description: This PHP class defines logic hooks for the Prospects module, specifically handling geocoding information updates related to the Jjwg Maps module within the SuiteCRM project. It interacts with external map-related functionalities to update geocoding data for prospect records and their related meetings.

classes.name: ProspectsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: Defines logic hooks for updating geocoding information in Prospects module utilizing the Jjwg Maps module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and loads the Jjwg Maps module information.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Hook method called before saving a prospect to update geocode info if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Hook method called after saving a prospect to update related meetings' geocode info if enabled.
